sources.label: Parches para Wallapop: modo oscuro negro OLED y desactivación de anuncios, compa
sources.author: Wallapop OLED and No Ads
patch_list: Disables Wallapop's central advertising eligibility gates. Does not unlock subscriptions or remove promoted marketplace listings.
Uses pure black for dark-mode Compose surfaces and themed legacy backgrounds. Preserves the original light palette, brand colours, text and icons. Follows Android dark mode.
